name: overall
sql: SELECT sum(CacheReadTokens) / nullif(sum(CacheReadTokens + CacheCreationTokens + (InputTokens - CacheReadTokens - CacheCreationTokens)), 0) AS hit_rate FROM agent_sessions WHERE StartedAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND StartedAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}

name: per_session
sql: SELECT SessionId AS id, Title AS title, CostUsd AS cost, CacheReadTokens / nullif(CacheReadTokens + CacheCreationTokens + (InputTokens - CacheReadTokens - CacheCreationTokens), 0) AS hit FROM agent_sessions WHERE StartedAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND StartedAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime} AND InputTokens > 0 ORDER BY hit DESC
